subject: Webinar: Observability x Cost — Speaker prep, localization & backup plan
content:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Anand <priya.anand@finoptics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar: Observability x Cost — Speaker prep, localization & backup plan

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to join our webinar on April 22. A few logistical items to lock down so we can finalize the run-of-show and give you the smoothest experience on the day of:

- Tech check windows (choose one): Apr 15 09:00–09:30 PT, Apr 16 16:00–16:30 PT, Apr 19 08:00–08:30 PT
- Slide deadline: Apr 18 EOD (we’ll do a final deck QA and add sponsor slide)
- Localization / captions: we’re planning live English captions + post-event vtt files in English, Spanish and Hindi. Do you want translated on-screen captions live or only post-event assets?
- Demo fallback: if the live demo (FinOptics demo portal) has latency we’ll switch to a pre-recorded screen capture that we’ll host; need to confirm that recording by Apr 18 if possible.

I attached the current run_of_show_v4.pdf and slide-upload-instructions.md. Karthik is our producer and will run the tech check; Soojin will handle stage liaison / speaker handovers.

If you can reply with your preferred tech-check slot, confirmation about localization expectations, and whether you can deliver a 7–10 minute demo recording by Apr 18 (if needed), we’ll lock everything in.

Thanks — excited to have you on the panel.

— Vivek
VP, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Dr. Priya Anand <priya.anand@finoptics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar: Observability x Cost — Speaker prep, localization & backup plan

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — I can do the Apr 16 16:00 PT tech check. For localization: English live captions are perfect. We’d like Spanish captions live if possible; Hindi can be post-event. Live Spanish would be valuable for our APAC attendees.

About the demo: our team can provide either a live demo against our staging portal (we’ll whitelist your IPs) or a 7-minute recording. Two quick constraints:
1) Our staging often has intermittent 3–8s page loads for heavy traces; if low latency on the webinar is critical we should use the recording as the primary and keep the live demo as a cold fallback.
2) Our UI has localized strings that sometimes clip; if you show the localized Spanish UI live, the layout might need minor CSS fixes.

I’ll attach a short bio and headshot in a follow-up email (small JPG). Slide deadline Apr 18 is fine.

Best,
Priya
CTO, FinOptics

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Anand <priya.anand@finoptics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar: Observability x Cost — Speaker prep, localization & backup plan

Hi all —

Confirmed: Apr 16 16:00 PT for the tech check. Agenda for the 30m:
- 5m intro / mic checks
- 10m slide pass + screen-share test (bring final slides or the single deck link)
- 10m demo run (live or recorded)
- 5m queues & fallback walkthrough (how we’ll swap to the pre-record if needed)

Priya — can you upload a quick 2-slide deck (title + demo brief) to the shared drive before the check so we can validate the deck link? I’ll send a calendar invite for the 16th with a Google Meet link.

Also: we need the sponsor logo (CloudBridge) and any legal copy for the sponsor slide by Apr 14 so design can finish the sponsor card.

— Karthik
Producer, Events

-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Anand <priya.anand@finoptics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Webinar: Observability x Cost — Speaker prep, localization & backup plan

Team / Elena —

Forwarding updated run-of-show (attached) with clarified cue times and a new demo-fallback protocol. Key changes since the last draft:
- 2:30pm PT event timing on Apr 22 (panel intro 2m, moderated convo 25m, live demo 10m, audience Q&A 15m)
- Demo fallback: control room will have the pre-record queued at 9s mark; producer will stand by to cut feed to recorded file if live latency > 5s for two consecutive interactions
- Live Spanish captions: we’ll use a third-party live translation feed (sponsored) — Elena, can you confirm CloudBridge is ok to provide a translator token for live captions?

Attachments: run_of_show_v4.pdf, slide-upload-instructions.md

Action items recap:
- Priya: confirm tech check slot + whether live Spanish is realistic (you had concerns about UI) — due Apr 5
- Elena: confirm translator token + sponsor card copy — due Apr 14
- Karthik: calendar invite + upload link for slide check — done by Apr 5
- Marissa / Soojin: collect headshot + short bio from Priya — due Apr 10

Thanks — Vivek

-----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudbridge.io>

Subject: Re: Webinar: Observability x Cost — Speaker prep, localization & backup plan

Hi Vivek / team —

CloudBridge can provide the live Spanish translator token — we’ll send the token and the integration guide by EOD Apr 9. Attached are the logo files (cloudbridge_logo_rgb.png, cloudbridge_logo_white.png) and the sponsor blurb. Please let us know if you need alternate sizes.

We’ll also confirm whether CloudBridge will run the live feed or if Redwood wants to integrate with our caption endpoint (we can support either by Apr 14).

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Partnerships, CloudBridge

Hi all —

Confirmed: I’ll join the Apr 16 16:00 PT tech check. We’ll plan the recording as the primary demo to avoid latency issues — I uploaded a 7:10 recording to the shared drive (filename: priya_demo_20270408.mp4).

Live Spanish captions: please proceed with the live feed — I’m comfortable with the translated captions as long as we don’t change the demo UI mid-run.

Attached: speaker-headshot-priya.jpg and a 3-sentence bio (copy pasted below). Slide deck will be uploaded by Apr 18 EOD.

Bio:
Dr. Priya Anand is CTO of FinOptics, where she leads the observability platform team building low-latency tracing for high-throughput services. Her team focuses on actionable signal and cost-aware sampling strategies.

See you on the 16th for the check.

— Priya
